{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for any rows with revenue exactly '999999.99'
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print("Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99':", qa_mask.sum())

# Check if any of these are in the 'loyal' segment
qa_in_loyal = df[qa_mask & (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')]
print("QA rows in loyal segment:", len(qa_in_loyal))

# Check if any of these are in the 'loyal' segment and have converted=1
print("QA rows in loyal segment with converted=1:", qa_in_loyal['converted'].sum())"}
